description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. No internal corridor — fully open layout. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: one sofa on the left side of the plan facing into the living space, near the windows. Dining table (4 seats). Entry: direct into living, first thing visible on arrival is kitchen. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Storage: one wardrobe. One bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: large families needing multiple bedrooms; households needing a home office with natural light; people who require a dedicated dining-TV viewing arrangement.
not_suitable_for: households needing a home office with natural light
